name: WARHAWK 707

specs.notes: 707 hp at 6,000 rpm and 875 N m (645 lb-ft) at 4,800 from the supercharged 6.2, 0-60 mph in 3.5 s, 180 mph, 2,433 kg (5,363 lb) curb, 2,916 mm wheelbase. The 8HP95's ratios (4.71 ... 0.67) and the 3.70 axle; Quadra-Trac sends up to 40 % forward in its track mode (40 % used).

garage.blurb: Seven hundred supercharged horsepower in a family SUV. Brutal off the line, heavy in the bends: it leans, squats and nods, and it wants the brakes early.

interior.notes: The model's own cabin (InteriorA textures, gauges, GPS screen); steering wheel cut out to turn, the lever animated.

limitations: The torque curve's shape, weight distribution and drag are estimates.
The OBJ's readme (in the package) restricts redistribution while the Sketchfab listing says CC BY 4.0; the owner cleared it ('i made it').
Jeep badges remain in its textures (grille, steering wheel).
No live gauges yet (data/dash): its own textured dials, the dome light.
